QuestInfo.name: Friend
QuestInfo.0: #p2411010#'s reckless incantations broke the curse, but also blew him up a little. He wasn't gravely injured, but #p2400005# and #p2400006# felt more than a little guilty.
QuestInfo.1: Once #p2411010# was healed, he told #p2400005# and #p2400006# that the shockwaves from the explosion had made the area unstable, then sent them away. They wondered if they would ever meet this wizard again...
QuestInfo.2: Was #p2411010# the same strange man in Maple World? #p2400005# and #p2400006# may not ever find out, but they had preparations to make for the relic.
